\section{\texttt{Telemetry}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.telemetry.Telemetry}\index{Classes!Telemetry}

Telemetry emitter that writes structured events to an optional sink.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
Telemetry(self, sink: TelemetrySink | None = None) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{sink}] \texttt{TelemetrySink \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Properties}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{enabled}] True when a sink is attached and events are recorded.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Without a sink the emitter is a cheap no-op, so instrumented code never needs to guard telemetry calls. Inject a sink (in-memory for tests, JSONL for local traces) to capture events.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}telemetry.\allowbreak{}py:202}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/936886da072fa7025a57c5517b9c90772bedae09/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/telemetry.py#L202}{online}), class, module \cref{module:feedback_intelligence_agent.telemetry}

\subsection{\texttt{span}}
\label{method:feedback_intelligence_agent.telemetry.Telemetry.span}\index{Methods!span}
Emit a started/finished event pair around a block of work.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
span(self, started_name: str, finished_name: str, *, correlation_id: str, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{started\_\allowbreak{}name}] \texttt{str}, required.
  \item[\texttt{finished\_\allowbreak{}name}] \texttt{str}, required.
  \item[\texttt{correlation\_\allowbreak{}id}] \texttt{str}, required, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{metadata}] \texttt{Mapping[str,\allowbreak{} Any]\allowbreak{} \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{Iterator[dict[str,\allowbreak{} Any]\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}}
\apifield{Details}Yields a mutable metadata dictionary so callers can attach result attributes (e.g. counts, scores) that should appear on the finished event. On error the finished event carries \texttt{status: error} and the exception message, and the exception is re-raised.
